# ForgingStack Quorum

> Before an agent acts alone, get the quorum. One proposal, N approvals, one receipt.

- Live API: https://forgingstack-quorum.jkbattles.workers.dev
- Product page: https://forgingstack.com/work/quorum/
- Public client repo: https://github.com/jdkabattles/forgingstack-quorum
- MCP Registry: io.github.jdkabattles/forgingstack-quorum

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/jdkabattles/forgingstack-quorum/blob/main/README.md) — signup, proposal flow, price, files
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/jdkabattles/forgingstack-quorum/blob/main/SKILL.md) — when to use it, how to read the result
- [agent-card.json](https://github.com/jdkabattles/forgingstack-quorum/blob/main/agent-card.json) — A2A-style discovery card

## Facts

- 1 credit per proposal; approvals are free.
- 100 free starter credits on signup; email verification required before the key can create proposals.
- $10 for 1,000 credits.
- MCP tools: create_proposal, get_proposal, get_credits, get_receipt (stdio, stdlib only).
